default_policy.top_p_fusion_diagnostic_note: Explicit WILDLLAMA_TOP_P_MASK_FUSION=1 permits supported fused graphs through1024 candidates. Expanded CUDA diagnostics are not automatic-default performance claims.
default_policy.dist_tail_fusion_diagnostic_note: Automatic only on the standard CPU buffer through1024 candidates. CUDA/other buffers retain legacy defaults; exact WILDLLAMA_DIST_TAIL_FUSION=1 enables supported diagnostics through1024.

sampling_prefill_components.scope: Actual model-free sampler allocations and synthetic-weight MoE workspace; CPU metadata is bounded, not free

moe_prepare_provider_gpu.scope: Tiny actual CUDA MoE provider controls; no large-model TPS or quality claim

concurrent_natural_comparison.scope: Actual concurrent printable-support outputs; changed batch composition may change greedy choices, so equality is reported rather than promised

positive.scope: Context-lifetime managed peaks of this fixture; no universal VRAM cap

complete_correctness.scope: Context-lifetime managed peaks of this fixture; no universal VRAM cap

cpu.scope: Positive100us separately proves no growth after adaptation and whole actual peaks<=disabled, including ordinary reservation; quiet ordinary-goal timing reports latency/TTFT/TPS tradeoffs

concurrent_natural_comparison.scope: Actual concurrent printable-support outputs; changed batch composition may change greedy choices, so equality is reported rather than promised

positive.scope: Context-lifetime managed peaks of this fixture; no universal VRAM cap

complete_correctness.scope: Context-lifetime managed peaks of this fixture; no universal VRAM cap

gpu.scope: Positive100us separately proves no growth after adaptation and whole actual peaks<=disabled, including ordinary reservation; quiet ordinary-goal timing reports latency/TTFT/TPS tradeoffs

adaptive_prefill_cpu_precision_diagnosti.scope: Controlled fixed histories, not exactHTTPscheduling; CPUFAcan change near-tie greedy choices. No trained-model quality or universal-output guarantee

historical_proof.literal_helper_comparison: Function text identical; only universal newline handling, no whitespace/code normalization
historical_proof.reason: The final large-vocabulary CPU component regressed; previous processes improved, so performance was not reliably nonregressing. Do not ship054. Candidate bits/allocation checks passed but do not override performance rejection.

sampler_scratch_withdrawal.scope: Historical baseline decision; old experiment is not rerun or copied into this release

existing_protocol_and_download_preservat.scope: The specific exercised existing protocol/download contracts, not universal behavioral equivalence or byte-identical source reproduction

installed_binary_source_correspondence.scope: Exact installed binary is the functional control. The source snapshot is curated from the deployed-feature worktree; its build was not byte-identical to the installed binary, so exact source correspondence is not claimed

deployment.commit_resolution: After sealing, the explicit deployed-feature source baseline, API changes and release record are committed atomically; Go installation independently verifies every compiled Go/module byte against final HEAD

Go_runtime_profile_controls.scope: Functional CPU-only synthetic fixture and actual deployed-binary protocol/download control. Only graph-cache budget, DRY and decode-overlap profile controls are advertised here. No trained-model quality, throughput, universal behavior/coverage or full WildGoose application validation claim

scope: Windows CPU/CUDA and local synthetic fixtures<=64MiB. No trained-model throughput or SGLang parity claim. Cache128MiB is a separately authorized experiment PER context; target+draft may each use it. Other model/KV/buffer and driver allocations are outside that cache accounting.
